put.description:
This service updates a personal identification number (PIN) for a card. This service requires both the current PIN and new cardholder-selected PIN in the message request. If the current PIN does not pass validation, the new PIN value will not be updated.

The PIN fail count is a program configuration that establishes the maximum number of bad PIN transaction attempts for a card. If the maximum PIN fail count for the card has been met, the PIN fail count must be reset on the card record before a PIN can be updated with this API.

As part of this API service, bad attempts to update a PIN for a card will also contribute to the PIN fail counter. As long as requests are valid, there is no limit to the number of times a PIN can be updated. The card record allows maintenance regardless of card status or expiration.

If creating a new card ID prior to calling this API, allow time for data synchronization between the Create Card ID response and this API request. When a card is replaced, a new card ID must be requested.

Message Level Encryption (MLE) is required for this service.

For BIN(s) configured with multiple PIN keys, expiration date is required. The API does not validate the expiration date, it uses the date to identify the PIN key used for calculation.

parameters.name: card-id
parameters.description: Unique ID for current card. minLength: 1, maxLength: 40.

post.description:
service creates a cardholder-selected personal identification number (PIN) for a card that is currently set to the natural PIN (for example, no customer-selected PIN exists). The customer-selected PIN will replace the natural PIN.

The PIN value passed through this API is the cardholder-selected value. The card record allows maintenance regardless of card status or expiration.

The PIN fail count is a program configuration that establishes the maximum number of bad PIN transaction attempts for a card. Successfully creating a card PIN with this service does not reset the PIN fail count. If the maximum PIN fail count for the card has been met, the PIN fail count must be reset on the card record before a cardholder-selected PIN can be established with this API.

If creating a new card ID prior to calling this API, allow time for data synchronization between the Create Card ID response and this API request. When a card is replaced, a new card ID must be requested.

Message Level Encryption (MLE) is required for this service.

For BIN(s) configured with multiple PIN keys, expiration date is required. The API does not validate the expiration date, it uses the date to identify the PIN key used for calculation.

parameters.description: Unique ID for current card. minLength: 1, maxLength: 40.

get.description:
This service allows a user interface to inquire on the card and card program regarding PIN service availability and card PIN status. The API returns two key pieces of information:

• Is PIN management supported on the card program

• Is PIN currently set for the card

If PIN management is supported and no PIN is set for the card, then a client will use the Create PIN API to set a cardholder-selected PIN.

If PIN is currently set for this card, then a client will use Update PIN API. Update PIN requires existing PIN to set a new value.

If creating a new card ID prior to calling this API, allow time for data synchronization between the Create Card ID response and this API request. When a card is replaced, a new card ID must be requested.

post.description:
This service creates a unique card ID for a Primary Account Number (PAN). It supports both DPS Debit and Prepaid clients.

For each card that is serviced, establishing the card ID is the first step. Subsequent API service requests primarily use the card ID in the message as the card reference value. The integrating system would either store or dynamically retrieve the card ID as needed. Exceptions to this may be inquiries using other reference values.

When a card is replaced, a new card ID must be requested for the new PAN. For PCI considerations, card numbers are masked in the response unless configured otherwise.

Considerations:

When creating a new card ID, Visa recommends allowing time for data synchronization between this API response and subsequent API requests.
post.operationId: Create Card ID for a PAN V2

post.description:
This service activates a card for a given Card ID, which is associated to a unique Primary Account Number (PAN). The service supports cardholder token verification as part of the card activation request. By default, at least one token is required in the request. If multiple tokens are provided, all tokens must pass validation prior to activation. If any token fails, activation will not be successful and a generic token failure message will be provided in the response.

For card replacements, a new Card ID must be requested for the new PAN.

This API was designed with considerations for self-service channels such as Voice Response Unit (VRU) automation, combining the token pass/ fail logic in addition to the basic function of activating a card. Other user interfaces such as websites, mobile applications, or enterprise administrative systems would also be able to take advantage of this service.

This version of the endpoint will be deprecated on July 31, 2025. Please leverage the most current version.

parameters.description: Unique ID for current card. minLength: 1, maxLength: 40.

This service digitally activates a card for a given card ID associated to a unique Primary Account Number (PAN). Digital activation supports the digital issuance product by allowing only specific card-not-present (CNP) and tokenized transactions. Digital activation is separate from card activation, which activates the physical card.

post.description:
This service activates a card for a given card ID associated to a unique Primary Account Number (PAN).

If creating a new card ID prior to calling this API, allow time for data synchronization between the Create Card ID response and this API request. When a card is replaced, a new card ID must be requested.

The DPS Debit Card Search API retrieves a list of Primary Account Numbers (PANs) associated with the search criteria provided. Possible search criteria options are account number and routing number, name, customer ID, card replacement number (CRN), and member number. Only one search criteria is supported per request.

The card status filter indicates if the result set should only include cards in good standing. Good standing refers to a card that is not in a negative or expired status. The initial card number may have expired but the lifecycle could have been extended, keeping the card in good standing. Cards returned may be active or inactive. Inactive cards are still eligible to be activated to perform transactions.

Message Level Encryption (MLE) is required for this service.

requestBody.description: Only one search criteria is supported per request. Either accountInfo, cardholderInfo, cardReplacementNumber, customerId, or memberNumber must be provided. When searching by accountInfo, accountNumber and routingNumber are required. When searching by cardholderInfo, firstName and lastName are required.

This service verifies cardholder information provided for a given card ID. It is only available for DPS Debit card programs. By default, at least one token is required in the request. If multiple tokens are provided, all tokens must pass validation for a successful response. If any token fails, a failure message will be provided in the response. For this API, a token is referred to as information unique to the cardholder that the cardholder either has (e.g. CVV2) or knows (e.g. phone number).

This service is commonly used as an authentication step to allow access to a self-service interface or as a prerequisite to allow use of other stand-alone services such as card activation.

If creating a new card ID prior to calling this API, allow time for data synchronization between the Create Card ID response and this API request. When a card is replaced, a new card ID must be requested.

accountId.description: The account ID uniquely identifies account(s) associated to the card ID.

currencyCode.description: 3-character ISO currency code. Applicable only if balances are returned.

accountNumber.description:
The account number is a funding source for the card. A card can have one or many accounts. For financial institutions, this generally refers to the checking account or savings account number.

Not applicable to Prepaid.

institutionId.description:
Identifies a client at DPS. This field is assigned by DPS and may appear on client reports. A client may be assigned multiple institution IDs as needed.

Not applicable to Prepaid.

ledgerBalance.description: Ledger balance can be equal to, greater than or less than available balance depending on subsequent settlement of pending transactions and deposits.

accountTypeCode.description: Account type code is an abbreviated code used to identify account type in DPS Debit and is a required field at account creation.

availableBalance.description: Available balance in default account currency. Amount available to use in this account.

fundingIndicator.description:
For point of sale (POS) activity, this field defines the funding account that is assigned to a transaction when the service line of the transaction is not known. Typically, primary and funding accounts are the same but can be different for investment accounts or other non-standard card-to-account associations.

Not applicable to Prepaid.

accountOpenedDate.description:
Assigned by client to identify date the account was established. The value is in UTC and the format is yyyy-MM-dd'T'hh:mm:ss.SSS'Z'.

Not applicable to Prepaid.

creditLineBalance.description:
Credit line balance is applicable to credit account types. Maximum credit applicable for the line of credit.

Not applicable to Prepaid.

isFundingComputed.description:
For POS activity, if the client did not set any accounts as a funding account, DPS Debit system uses other fields (DDA, Primary, other) to identify whether funding indicator is set by the client or is computed by DPS.

Not applicable to Prepaid.

accountIndicatorCode.description: This field is only used for ATM services, where multiple account selections are available.

accountTypeDescription.description:
Account type assigned to the account when it was created from a pre-defined enumeration list. In DPS Debit, this is an optional field at account creation.

Not applicable to Prepaid.

availableCreditBalance.description:
Available credit balance is applicable to credit account types. Difference between credit used and maximum credit balance.

Not applicable to Prepaid.

lastBalanceUpdateTimeStamp.description: Date/time account balance was changed. The value is in UTC and the format is yyyy-MM-dd'T'hh:mm:ss.SSS'Z'.

accountIndicatorDescription.description:
Account indicator description matches the selected account indicator code.

Not applicable to Prepaid.

prcId.description: The Issuer (PRC) level for U.S. card programs processed by Visa DPS.

netTotal.description: Net Total of items 2 through 9 (should be equal to 1) Net total of line items 2 through 8. This net total should equal line item 1, the daily wire transfer amount.

differences.description: Difference The difference between line items 1 and 9.

wireTotalAmount.description: Wire Total Amount Total dollar amount of the wire transfer. This is a net total of all credit transactions less all debit transactions, applicable fees, and dispute items.

processorSettlementAmount.description: Processor Settlement Report EF500210-RP03 Provides the net total of all cardholder activity and terminal activity processed through Visa DPS. This net total represents activity settled by Visa DPS for the current business date. The net cardholder and terminal activity are reported on the Processor Settlement Report EF500210-RP03.

miscellaneousFeesSettlementAmount.description: Miscellaneous Fees Settlement Detail DD0716-D02 Provides the net total of administrative fees initiated and received by your institution. This net total represents activity settled for the current VisaNet business date. The net issuer and acquirer total is reported on the Miscellaneous Fees Settlement Summary DD0716-D01, D02.

exceptionTransactionSettlementAmount.description: Exception Transaction Settlement Detail DD0714-D02 Provides the net total of all chargebacks, representments, and adjustments. This net total represents activity settled by the networks and passed to Visa DPS for the current business date. The net issuer and acquirer total is reported on the Exception Transactions Settlement Detail and Summary reports DD0714-D01, D02.
